verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

xrefs.text: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one considers that the righteous are taken away from the presence of evil.

“Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem. Look now and take note; search her squares. If you can find a single person, anyone who acts justly, anyone who seeks the truth, then I will forgive the city.
Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
See how the faithful city has become a harlot! She once was full of justice; righteousness resided within her, but now only murderers!

verses.text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.

xrefs.text: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.

verses.text: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.

xrefs.text: Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

While I was contemplating the horns, suddenly another horn, a little one, came up among them, and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like those of a man and a mouth that spoke words of arrogance.
The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

verses.text: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips— who can be our master?”

xrefs.text: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
But Pharaoh replied, “Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.”
Yet they say to God: ‘Leave us alone! For we have no desire to know Your ways.
He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.

Then some said, “Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah, for the law will never be lost to the priest, nor counsel to the wise, nor an oracle to the prophet. Come, let us denounce him and pay no heed to any of his words.”

verses.text: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”

xrefs.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him.
Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

verses.text: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.

xrefs.text: Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.

verses.text: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.

xrefs.text: He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.

verses.text: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.

xrefs.text: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials will be wicked.
At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “Why do we need any more witnesses?
Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.
The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.
